name: Scaffolding
game_text:
Plays to your support area.
Each time a regroup action discards an <culture>Isengard</culture> Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card.
<phase>Response</phase>: If an <culture>Isengard</culture> Orc is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards stacked here to prevent that wound.
flavor_text: Towers marked the inner ring, implements of industry.
